notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.632 - Old and New cards updated
notes.notes:
Greetings, Aspiring Dark Mages!

This patch is a spicy one—while it includes a few minor tweaks, it also brings some serious updates to the Keen-Eye Tribe deck (yes, again!) and the long-neglected Zombie Lord deck. Oh, and good riddance to a pretty useless card—I've replaced it with something far more exciting!

Let’s dive into the state of the game...

⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️
- Heroic Souls will now be collected when time runs out, as long as they were harvested and en route to the Dark Tower.
- Cold mechanics during the Day: Cold now drops faster during an Icestorm. Previously, players lost 5 Cold every 5 TUs. With this update, you now lose 1 extra Cold per Icestorm level:

 If Cold ≥ 40: lose 6 Cold every 5 TUs
 If Cold ≥ 60: lose 7 Cold every 5 TUs
 If Cold ≥ 80: lose 8 Cold every 5 TUs


🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏
- Burning Shard has been removed! I'm beginning to phase out elemental cards (waiting for a chance to shine again in teh future!), and this is the first to go. But don’t worry—a new card rises in its place:
- Library Rat (NEW): The Rats welcome a powerful new ally—a Rat Mage! He shuffles every card from your graveyard back into your deck and applies POISON to each Villager per card shuffled. Time his appearance wisely for massive poison stacks!
- Keen-Eye Tribe (starter deck): Once again updated to better synergize with the theme of managing a "mild" Icestorm.
- Zombie Lord (starter deck): While the basic deck remains untouched, all Upgraded cards have received major enhancements:

 Gangrenous Zombies will keep crawling toward the Village even after being defeated.
 Zombie Twins now react with grief (and fury!) when one sibling is slain.
 Revolting Returns has a chance to raise an extra Crawling Zombie.

- Titan on Attack: Upon death, he now splits into two parts—upper body and lower legs—each continuing the fight for the glory of the Dark Mage!
- Dear Dead Friend: Its Demise effect has been softened slightly. Upon defeat, it now spawns a Weeping Soul, which slowly reduces the Rage value unless killed.
-Deranged Miner & Hewers: These gold-crazed diggers now have the ROAMING ability, wandering the battlefield in search of Iceshards to smash into gold.
 
🐛 BUGS 🐛
- Nothing major, just some typo corrections and UI animation fixes.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰

That’s all for now! Looking ahead, we're preparing another update focused on phasing out more Elemental cards. That tribe never quite got the love they deserved, and it's time to shift our focus deeper into the Demon family, especially what's lurking in the 3rd Hell: Thul.

Upcoming changes will also affect many cards in the Corruption and Destruction domains:

 Destruction Demons will be slightly redesigned to better reflect their chaotic nature.
 Corruption Demons will begin to unleash their... tempting powers.


Stay tuned. Stay evil. 😈

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.63 - The Cold before the Storm.
notes.notes:
Greetings, Aspiring Dark Mages!

I’ve added some cool updates to Frost—literally. Things are a bit tougher, a lot more immersive, and way more fun as you climb the ranks of icy badassery. Go check below what’s new!

⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️

-- Keen-Eye Starter Deck: The entire deck has been revamped! Every single card has been rebalanced or redesigned. Test it out and discover how the new changes play out!

- Ice Shards: Now generates 1 Cold every 6 TUs for a total duration of 30 TUs. Cold will no longer decrease at the end of Ice Shards life cycle.

- Ice Storm: The effects of this spell have been significantly overhauled and now scale better with Cold! 

Each Villager will suffer the following effects every 5 TUs if Cold reaches these thresholds:

Cold 40+: Each Villager receives Slow 1.

Cold 60+: Each Villager receives Slow 2 and -1 Attack Damage.

Cold 80+: Each Villager receives Slow 3, -1 Attack Damage, and takes 2 Damage.

- Slow Debuff: Enemies affected by Slow will now retain a minimum speed of 1. This keeps Slow strategies viable, while making them slightly less dominant.

🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏

- Blizzard: no longer generates Cold based on Ice Shards. Instead, it deals 1 Damage to each Villager for each Ice Shard in play. Additionally, Blizzard now refreshes the duration of each Ice Shard on the battlefield! To balance this powerful effect, the cost has been increased to 6 TUs.

- Ostearch Maiden/Handmaid: The Health of this minion has been slightly increased.

- Frost Sword: The Damage boost is now limited to +5.

🐛 BUGS 🐛

- Fixed incorrect Experience values when player reaches Level 24.

-Fixed a bug on "Corrupted Preciousss" card when cast with 2+ Gold Nuggets on the Battlefield.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰

The Frost experience might be nearly complete, but there's still plenty on the horizon! I'm getting closer to rolling out those long-promised features, and here's a sneak peek at what's coming:

- New game modes
- The Malice/Virtue System – the ultimate challenge for those brave enough to challenge Glowing Skull runs.
- New vendors to discover and deal with
- More Limited Edition cards, including some all-new Limited Edition minions
- Standalone decks – a set of compact Starter decks with unique mechanics outside the main 4 Domains

Big things are on the way—stay tuned, and of course... stay evil. 😈

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.63 - Bigger on the inside!
notes.notes:
Hello Aspiring Dark Mages!

This new patch is a weird one... it was supposed to be a routinary patch to fix the usual small bugs that arise here and there and it slowly became a game-changer! You'll notice a longer than usual list of changes and updates! Some core mechanics are impacted aswell, hopefully for the best!

Without further ado, here is the list of what is new in game!

🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️
- Rulebook: the Rules for the game can now be conveniently accessed both from the Main Menu and in the Shop, in case you wish to review some mechanics of the game before purchasing new cards or upgrades...
- Miracles: the new Miracles introduced with the big Frost game update were... Boring? Bad? Wards were particularly nasty, as they were either useless or devastating, based on your deck build. They were just un-funny, hence I redesigned almost each of the "Rune" Miracles. Just check the Library to see how those updated Miracles work!
- Flesh Cult Deck: this deck received a Major update! The card Spring Cleaning/Make Room was deemed very powerful. Now it is an Unleash card that launches Corpses on the Battlefield at a controlled rate, rather than being both an awesome Corpse generator and a very reliable defensive tool. The Flesh Collector is now a Sadistic Butcher! To compensate the reduced Corpse generation, now this updated minion has a Loop ability that self-inflicts damage to create Corpses. The old healing ability still stands so...
- Ratageddon Deck: also the Rats of Doom received a big update of one of their least favourite card: Gnawing Critters is now an Unleash card that transform Corpses into Rats whenever you play a "Rat" card.

⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️
- Game Difficulty & Miracles: this is partially a retrace of a former change, but I feel it is needed. The rate at which Miracles are added to deck changed for 0 and 1 Skull runs. Now at 0 Skulls players will receive a single Miracle from Rounds 10 to 15. In 1 Skull runs Miracles will be added at Rounds 5, 10 and 15, making a total of 3 Miracles for the last round. Higher difficulties Miracle ratios are unaltered.
- Necropotence: significant nerf. Now you will no longer get a Devotion skelly but "just" a Skeleton Crackhead, a fighter unit that is not even considered a Minion. Former version of the Death Pact was objectively overpowered.
- Ice Shards: they now generate 5 Cold upon entering the battlefield (was 6).
- Cold Generation: flat cold generation has been reduced all over the game. Too many small changes to track them, generally cards/minions will add less Cold, generate less shards or card cost received small tweeks.
- Icestorm: damage reduced. Was 1/3/5 for the three tiers of storm intensity, now it is 1/2/3 and applies Slow 1/2/3 aswell.
- Ghoran Profit: mechanic for this hidden skill has been changed. Now when you hit the Oblation action, if you have this skill, you'll also destroy each Gold Nugget on the Battlefield. Then you'll draw a card for every 2 Gold destroyed this way.

🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏
- Ostearch Maiden: mechanic reworked. Now the skeletal lady gained two Warcry abilities: one will summon an Ostearch Despoiler if you have 6 or more cards in hand, the second will summon a Ostearch Despoiler if there are 6 or more cards in the Graveyard.
- Snow Imp: now the imps will destroy the Gold Nugget closest to the Dark Tower.
- March of the Dead: big change! This card was another one clearly too powerful for its rarity and intended gameplay... It has been redesigned completely: now will summon a Spear Skeleton when the player casts a "Skeleton" card (any Minion card having the Skeleton trait) and will summon a Rotten Zombie when the player casts a "Zombie" card (again, any Minion card having the Zombie trait). This change is justified largely by the sheer amount of crazy builds that allowed to beat the game too easily once in possession of two copies of this card! 

🐛 BUGS 🐛
- Patched Thing: source code was very old and had conflicts with the new Entombed mechanics. 
- Keen-Eye Invoker: the upgraded Stormcaller had an higher than intented Health charateristic (19!!). Now it has 10 Hp as planned.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠

Big changes! I want to thank personally user Faust who provided an insane amount of feedback and suggestions (this ahs been an ongoing help since the demo days!!!). If you feel there are broken mechanics that need some attention, please write about it in the game forum of join my Discord for a personal touch! :D

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.2
notes.notes:
Hello, aspiring Dark Mages!

With this patch there are many new features in the game: a card library, a deck button, a screen to recap your performance! Also 12 new cards, while some others have (temporarily?) left the game, waiting for the right moment to come back! Also, some pesky bugs have been solved, one still tied to the despicable "Immortal Village" of the last month...

Without further ado, here is the list of what is new in game!

🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️
- 12 new cards! The last remaining cards for Death, Destruction and Corruption domains enter the fray! Each domain received 3 new Rare cards and 1 Epic card. These cards will be unlocked at level 18 and, oh boy, there are some powerful ones to explore! For Death the spotlight goes to the Surviving Vampire who is invulnerable during the Night. Destruction received a new powerful Pyromancy: Fire Trap! If you have trouble dealing with the party of Heroes, this is the card for you! And last but not least, The All-Eater for Corruption will devour anything on its path growing stronger as it crawls its way to the Village!
- Death Guard deck revamped! This tier 5 deck for Death domain has been revamped. Some cars are gone (Shield Skeleton and 2 Minutes to Midnight) but other powerful cards replaced them: Skeletal Captain and Skeletal Deathwish! 
- Run Recap: when victorious in a Deck run, a screen will recap you score, your deck and your upgrades! Time to brag about it with your friends!
- Deck Button: the deck button in a Round is now clickable and will show the cards in the deck (not in draw order ofc!). Now you will know what's left to draw and the odds for drawing the card you are waiting for.
- Card Library! The first version for a Card Library has landed! You can now explore all the cards you have unlocked. Mind that this is just the first version: in the future each card will be interactable and will provide extensive information about rules and lore!

⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️
- Draft Run tuned: Draft run has been slightly reworked in how the Village grows in power. The goal was to make Rounds 20-25 the highest ones but I'm sure someone will find a way to hit Rounds 30+!
- The Throne button (for those who unlocked it) will be deactivated during Draft Runs, as no Blood Skulls are given in this game mode.
- Scroll windows no longer have any annoying elastic effect and the content is clamped.

🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏
- Some Limited Edition cards received a slight buff in their cost. The effects are unchanged.
- Cursed Bellringer: this Minions received the Defender ability and will from now on remain safely under the tower consistently providing its ability to draw a card when you play a Miracle.
- Shield Skeleton/2 Minuts to Midnight/Zombie Cutthroath have temporarily left the game to give room to more interesting cards.

🐛 BUGS 🐛
- Rat Emperor: he wisely decided to boost the speep of the Swarms in its command AFTER spawning a Swarm and not the other way around... 
- Miracles will no longer POP if not in hand when timer reach zero.
- Boss name will correctly appear in the Battle Preview.
- Bosses came back! For a while, only the Valkirye and the Ovinomancer were selected as Bosses for a run. Now all bosses are back in the game! (And I shouldn't say this, but it seems like 7 new Bosses will be added to the game in the future... shhhhhh!)

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾

That's it for now! As usual, please inform me should you find bugs or issues! And as usual, I'm all ears listening to your suggestions, feedback and also ideas for new features for the game! Just join my Discord (button below) or write about your findings/ideas on the forum!

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.2
notes.notes:
Hello, aspiring Dark Mages! 

For the first time, new content has arrived for The Dark Horde! Also, I have changed some prices here and there (Mirror's Overseer, I'm talking to you!) and solved a bug that involved the Draft Mode. Finally, newcomers will have an easier way beating the early game as zero Skulls runs will no longer clog the players' decks with those pesky Miracles...
Here comes the list of evrything new in the game!

🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️

- Blood Throne completely reworked! End game will be completely different now, as Dark Mages who managed to collect 1 or more Blood Skulls will have new opportunities to spend their precious Skulls! In particular, at the cost of 4 Blood Skulls, you can now purchase Limited Edition cards! 
- 9 New Cards: 3 cards for each Domain in the game, with new powerful cards like the Incubus, the Ritual of Fire or the Swallowing Mass! Each Domain has 2 new Uncommon cards and 1 new Rare card.
- Envoys of Ghor deck [Destruction Tier 5]: completely reworked! Mischievous Imps and Corpse Demon cards now have new mechanics. 
- Twisted Forest deck: cards/characters were reskiinned to have a cohesive theme. [same as above.]
- Rats now have the Rat race keyword. While cool to have, this has no impact in any mechanic of the game. Yet! 

⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️

- Blood Skulls are given at a rate of 1 per Round, up to the maximum Blood Skulls collected.
- Resources are limited to 99 units. Each extra resources collected while at 99 are lost.
- The rate at which the amount of Dark Gems awarded increase with Round number has been slightly decreased.
- Zero Skull runs from now on will have no Miracles to thwart your run! After all, they will come in full force at every higher difficulty... 
- Goblin Looters steal only 3 Gold when pillaging the Village (was 5).
- The cost to duplicate cards at the Mirror's Overseer is now 7 Heroic Souls (was 5).
- The cost to remove a card from the deck at the Mirror's Overseer is now 5 Heroic Souls (was 3)
- Upgrading a Forge costs 1 Dark Gems less for each rank (a single Forge now requires 16 Dark Gems, was 20).
- Along Envoys of Ghor deck rework, the staple card Blood-Eye Possessed/Vessel has been slightly nerfed, dealing 1 less damage to the Village when the condition is met.
- Restoring 1 lost Health of the Dark Tower now costs 2 Gold and 2 Common Souls (was 3 of each)
- A single Blood Skull restores 4 lost Health (was 2).
- Cards found in any booster (even Limited Edition ones!) can now be rerolled by paying 2 Gold or 2 Common Souls. In case, you can still spend a Dark Gem, if you have one to spare...
- Common Souls collected and on their way to the Dark Tower will be automatically collected when the Time is up! Goblins will still need to reach the vanishing Dark Tower to unload the Gold... Also, this change does not apply to Heroic Souls: those are collected the hard way. This also means that the Vacuum Cleaner upgrade now only works for Common Souls not being collected, as the others will already be affected by this change.
- Heroic Souls acquired at the Trader in the Necro-Comicon will not be counted for the final score.


🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏

- Bone Mastery: TU cost increased from 3 to 5.
- Rat King: now has a WARCRY ability (was DEMISE) that doubles the move speed of Swarm of Rats / Lab Rats.
- The Ecstasy of Gold: once again, this card required a nerf... I added a 55 TUs internal cooldown to the ability. You can still pop 4-10 Goblin Looters with proper deckbuilding/RnG. 
- Monstrance Clock: removed a small delay that caused the ability to trigger 1 TU later than intended.
- Twisted Forest/Envoys of Ghor decks: reworked, no point in listing all the changes.
 
📖 GAME READABILITY 📖

- The size of highlighted cards has been increased.

🐛 BUGS 🐛

- Draft Mode is playable once again! Sorry for the regression introduced when I added Miracles Reroll and Miracles saves... Also, the Village will have 1 Health Point per Round as expected, no longer idling at 20 just to be nuked down by a bunch of Vessels...
- Added a check for Progression Achievements (Level, Skulls, Blood Skulls) when you load the Main Menu. In case, for some reason, the Steam API didn't register the achievement unlocked...
- Fixed a rare bug where Souls flew over the Dark Tower withiut being collected properly.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾

As usual, please inform me should you find bugs or issues! And as usual, I'm all ears listening to your suggestions, feedback and also ideas for new features for the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.11
notes.notes:
Aspiring Dark Mages, this is the first patch for The Dark Horde! I will list below all the medium/small changes in the game and the fixes to bugs found during its first week. All these were simple changes requested by players. There are a couple things that will require more effort, the Card Library being of top of the Most Request features. It will be there. Just not "soon".

🛠️ NEW FEATURES 🛠️
- Card Rerolls: the cards found in a booster can now be rerolled at the cost of 1 Dark Gem.
- Pause Button: a button to access pause menus have been added to the Main Menu, the Shop and the Round scenes.
- Miracle Rerolls: now rerolled miracles are saved and not reverted to the original Miracle(s) if you retry the Round.
- Restart Options: now you can Restart a Round anytime from the pause menu. And the option the retry the Round will be offered in the recap screen even if you were victorious, in case you think you can do better.
- Rulebook: the Rulebook now provides information about Devotion mechanic, Sacrifice mechanic and how bonus Dark Gems are awarded.

⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️
- Action Buttons Upgrade: are now available from level 1 in the shop.
- Miracle Progression: the rule that randomize Miracles has changed. Now at level 4 and level 8 the most complex Miracles will be secretly unlocked for randomization. Basically this means that new player will not find complex Miracles like High Priestess, The Moon, The Sun or The Hanged Man.
- Raze and Swiftness bonus increased: now you will gain more Dark Gems at higher Rounds if you manage to destroy the Village and when you do that in the very first day of a Round.
- Orcish Barrage: the Orc Archers will now spawn after 8 TUs rather than 4.

📖 GAME READABILITY 📖
- Warnings Text: the size of the Warning Messages have been increased, mostly to accomodate Steamdeck players.
- Boon Tooltip: now you can mouse over Boon upgrades you purchased to have the information about their effect.
- Boss Preview: at the beginning of Rounds 9 and 15 of a Deck run you will receive the information of which boss you are going to face.

🖼️ ART 🖼️
- New Time Unit icon: the icon for Time Units have changed.
- New Domain Boosters Cost icon: a small "+" in the icon should now make it clear that boosters cost 3 gold and 3 common souls.

🐛 BUGS 🐛
- Iconoclasm: solved a bug that caused discarded Miracles to calculate the unleash countdown incorrectly.
- Slow Motion: fixed a bug that made time run inconsistently in some occasions at the end of a Round.
- Chosen Harbinger: fixed the spawn point of its magic missiles.
- Blood Skulls: the information about how many Blood Skulls you collected will be correctly shown in the Main Manu.
- Overlapping Loading in Menu: you can no longer go back to the Files Selection Menu and launch a run at the same time if you are quick enough.
- Minor typos: typos have been fixed here and there (Titan on Attack no longer has Stun, the Fear ability tooltip is fixed, ...)

notes.title: DEVLOG #3.5 - Since I had the time... here is a demo update!
notes.notes:
Hello Aspiring Dark Mages! 

Just a few days ago I posted the last DEVLOG update before the Early Access release. But then I realized that many things were updated in the actual game and the demo was left behind on balancing cards, UI update and many small things... 

Since I won't ever remove the demo (so people will have a clear idea if The Dark Horde is the game for them or not BEFORE committing to it...), I guess it is better to just update the few things that changed! Some players might notice that some of their favourite cards have received this rebalancing. Most notably, a few costs have been increased or reduced but the greatest impact has been for the Shambling Flesh: I added more HP to the nasty beast but I decresed the Trample value from 2 to 1. Trust me, this impacts greatly how deadly the Shambling Flesh minion impact the battlefield...

Anyway, for all the new players that will find this game in the upcoming weeks, here is a demo in line with the upcoming Early Access release!

If you want a deeper list of what the EA release will have, please refer to DEVLOG #3, where I wrote the list of what is and of what will be!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Something new and another demo update
notes.notes:
Hello Dark Mages!

This update is necessary for a couple of reasons. First, I have updated the demo, again! Some of my most awesome Dark Horde lovers pointed out some aspected about the new Miracles Reroll feature introduced with the last Demo patch. So I had to fix that, even just for the demo! While I was at it, I also updated some other things you might notice. So, here is the list of what is new with this new Demo update:

- Miracles are now saved! This means that if you reroll the Miracles and then retry the level, the initial pool of Miracles will be the same (and the Dark Gem used for the Reroll will be lost). Avoiding those pesky Miracles you hate to draft won't be that easy!
- Fixed a configuration bug where Goblin Looters triggered events for Minions. Goblin Looters are worthless, they don't deserve to be considered Minions.
- Fixed the count of cards when Miracles are added to the deck.
- Added a fancy Yellow glow for Rare cards! (Also added a Purple glow for Epic cards aswell, but those are not available yet...)

Now that the Demo is sorted out, let's see what I recently added for the actual game in Early Access:

- the last remaining basic feature, card removal, has been added for a vendor in the Necro Comicon festival. At the cost of 3 Heroic Souls you will be able to permanently remove 1 of the 4 cards that have been part of your deck the longest. This feature has been added to the Mirror Overseer vendor, that you can unlock once you reach level 8. This vendor has also the wonderful ability to duplicate a card already in your deck for the modest price of 5 Heroic Souls...
- I balanced some cards you haven't seen yet. I'm sure there will be more unbalanced cards at Release, but that's what Early Access is there for: receiving feedback!
- I fixed a SERIOUS bug that involved the Endless Mode of the game. 

I think that what will be in the first Early Access release is pratically ready for publishing to be honest! But let's wait for summer to end instead of rushing things... after all, Fall is a better season to lay waste on enemy villages...

notes.title: Post SNF Demo Update
notes.notes:
New update to inform you that I have updated the demo, fixing various small and big things and adding a new important features! 

This update is basically a players driven update: most of the changes were suggestions/opinions/ideas brought by players! Here is the list of evrything new/changed:

FIX:
- Peasants' spawn rate reported incorrect values after using cards like Titan On Attack or The Chariot
- various texts have been changed/corrected
- Deafeat Texts: have been updated aswell: no more mockery but lore based messages
- Tutorial updated: slight changes made on the tutorial to highliight the meaning of Time Units (TUs) and their impact in the game

CARD UPDATES:
- CG FOUL PLAYS: a new Destruction sorcery card has been added!
- Lust for Gold/Crave Riches: the Gold will no longer be pulled behind the Tower, out of reach for your poor goblin Looters
- Dance Macabre/Endless Dance: the card felt a bit weak and now there is the additional effect of Harvesting all Souls when played

NEW FEATURES:
- YOU TURN! When it is your turn to play a card or action, the central text will clearly notify you!
- MIRACLES REROLL: on Deck Runs you will be informed of which Miracles are about to be added to your deck for that Round. If you want, now you can spend 1 Dark Gem to reroll all the Miracles, hoping for a less punishing set of Miracles for your deck
